# Freya Bank — Early Collections Policy Extract (effective 2026-07-01)
A promise date must be on or after `now`'s calendar date, must fall on a working day, and must not fall after the latest promise date for the band.
Working days for deadline and promise dating are Monday through Friday.
Add **19 October 2026** (Freya Foundation Day) to the early-collections holiday list.
Promise dates and deadlines must skip this day.
The July extract's other holidays are unchanged.
Business days remain Monday–Friday except the holidays listed above (including the new 19 October date).

The early band is unchanged: 1 to 7 days late → 12th business day after today.

A promise date must be on or after `now`'s calendar date, must fall on a working day, and must not fall after the latest promise date for the band.

day_month_swapped hint: ask for the month as a word; that retry is free (not a wrong answer).

source.quote: Credit card: floor equals the account field `minimum_payment`.
Personal loan or car loan: floor equals the account field `instalment_amount`.
Pull get_account.
Then you may say you are calling from collections about a late payment, name the product in words, state past-due amount and days late.

amounts.first_ask: propose the full past-due amount first, asking: Can you make this payment today?
amounts.too_much: offer the floor once and note that the remainder stays overdue
amounts.below_floor: not accepted; never ask the customer how much they can pay

source.quote: Always propose the full past-due amount first.
Never ask the customer how much they can pay.
If the full amount is too high, offer the floor once and note that the remainder stays overdue.
Amounts from the floor up to the full past-due amount (inclusive) may be accepted.
We only dial accounts that are between 1 and 45 days past due on one product.

source.quote: Every call ends with one `close_call`.
promise (no reason) — at least one promise recorded
paid (no reason) — customer asserts this past-due amount was already paid
transferred — reasons restructuring | human | support
no_promise — reasons refused | hardship | dispute | service_error
not_verified — reasons failed | declined
not_reached — reasons callback | no_callback | wrong_number | deceased | unclear
OUT_PROM,REASON_NONE,promise,,Promise recorded; API reason must be omitted/empty
OUT_PAID,REASON_NONE,paid,,Customer asserts past-due already paid
We still close every call with exactly one close_call.
